name: News Audio Briefing
description: Live web search on any topic from the last 24 hours, written into a spoken ~2 minute briefing and read aloud to an audio file. Give it a topic like 'the latest AI news'.
author: mchatai-labs
notes: Search runs through Perplexity sonar with recency=day. No API key needed if you are signed in and have compute tokens: the research provider ladder falls back BYO key -> mChatAI Cloud tokens -> ungrounded (with an honest disclaimer). Speech uses your Mac's built-in voice by default, so audio needs no setup. To generate the script locally for free instead, change the second step's llmProvider to "ollama". Pairs well with a daily schedule.
